verdict.rationale: Evidence is entirely first-party marketing copy about battery life and general 'smart power efficiency,' with no documented power envelopes (TDP tables, sustained wattage specs) and no independent testing or benchmarks of sustained rendering/export performance per watt. missing for 10: documented power envelope specs (base/sustained TDP), independent hands-on sustained-load benchmarks, thermal throttling data during long export/render workloads.
